behavior.precondition: Registered target database with catalogue schema
behavior.contract: Metadata refresh does not install importable code or overwrite operational state
behavior.postcondition: Existing installed/pending states preserved; new available modules uninstalled; dependency metadata reconciled atomically
behavior.invariant: One refresh uses one database; failed dependency write rolls back the refresh
behavior.exceptions: Unknown aliases rejected before writes; operational signal failures remain errors

incremental_contracts.execution_flow: Command --database -> atomic(target) -> locked catalogue -> existing parser -> explicit .using(target) -> dependency reconciliation -> report from persisted installed states
incremental_contracts.inputs_outputs: Alias and available manifests -> metadata changes/report, not installation
incremental_contracts.side_effects: Catalogue/dependency metadata only; no module DDL or hook execution; atomic rollback
incremental_contracts.existing_adaptation: Django manager alias and native transactions replace cursor-bound Odoo env
incremental_contracts.limitations: Two-DB refresh probe uses matching metadata fixtures (zero metadata writes); first signal-boundary probe proves actual metadata writes in all-addon runtime can invoke automation without the database alias. Not complete catalogue/loader acceptance.

behavior.precondition: Persisted module in selected catalogue; system actor; existing available/installable dependencies
behavior.contract: Queue administrative transitions in correct database without claiming executed installation
behavior.postcondition: Install orders closure and auto candidates; upgrade includes installed dependents; uninstall queues dependents and protects base
invariants: No partial transitions on invalid dependency/cycle/external requirement
Bound module/dependency/exclusion uses its own database
A dependency batch cannot mix databases with colliding IDs
exceptions: ValidationError for missing/disabled module, unavailable binary, incompatible modules or mixed database batches

incremental_contracts.execution_flow: System guard -> atomic(bound alias) -> ordered row locks -> existing dependency traversal/ModuleGraph -> dependency checks -> SQL state updates
incremental_contracts.inputs_outputs: Bound module plus requested operation -> ordered module names and pending persisted states
incremental_contracts.side_effects: State updates only, transactionally; no schema/data/hook execution. Native migration0087 changes field choices/help, not a taxonomy migration.
incremental_contracts.installed_mechanism: IrModule methods; existing ModuleGraph, external-dependency checker, dependency traversals and Django transactions
incremental_contracts.existing_adaptation: Django single-instance administrative calls return technical module lists rather than a web-client action dictionary
verification: database-module-states.json: distinct states, concurrent requests, rollback, one-query bound batch and mixed-ID rejection
incremental_contracts.limitations: Pending requests do not consume Registry.new installation arguments. Full loader, installed-version separation, country/category exclusion semantics and process refresh require further implementation and acceptance. No production global class mutation or per-request INSTALLED_APPS changes.
